label: Create Lead
description: Create a lead. Dedups by email — returns the existing lead with duplicate: true instead of a second row.
output: The created lead (id, email, first_name, last_name, company, job_title, status, tags, created_at) plus duplicate: true when the email already existed.
notes: SKELETON — part of the Make custom-app spec (see integrations/make/app.json). Build this module in Make's web UI / VS Code from this spec; the endpoint (method + path) is the contract the module must call.
